- **Cosine recurrence:** cos(arctan x) = 1/√(1+x²), so b_{n+1}² = 1/(1+sin²a_n) = 1/(2−b_n²). This is correct.

- **Product:** The product c_1⋯c_16 telescopes to 1/(3·16+1) = 1/49. So b_1⋯b_16 = 1/7 (all cosines are positive), and the requested reciprocal is 7.
